verdict.rationale: The Jobs API documents a create-time option that parses speakers from multi-channel audio and assigns one speaker per channel. That directly keeps each side of a stereo or multi-track call separate in the transcript. Evidence is a single short parameter description. missing for 10: details on per-channel output structure and supported channel counts, behavior for stereo vs. many channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, stereo or multichannel recordings can be transcribed per channel, so each side of a call stays separate

citations.quote: When enabled, parses speakers from multi-channel audio by assigning one speaker per channel. Useful for multi-track recordings.
